indexedAt.description: When this activity happened, and the feed's sort key. Prefer this over createdAt for display: createdAt is frozen at record creation, so it does not move when a book is finished or reviewed.

feedGroup.description: One row of the feed. A burst collapses a run of same-actor, same-verb activity (a CSV import or library re-sync) into a single row.

verb.description: Display verb for the row, e.g. "finished", "wants to read", or "logged" when a burst spans several statuses.

total.description: Number of activities in a burst. Absent or 1 for a single.

truncated.description: True when the burst was force-closed at a page boundary, so total is a floor rather than an exact count.

main.description: Get the activity feed. Requires authentication for the friends and tracking tabs.

tab.description: Which feed tab to show. Defaults to friends.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response. Preferred over page.

collapse.description: Collapse import/re-sync bursts into grouped rows. Pass false for a flat activity list.

page.description: Deprecated and ignored: use cursor. Retained so existing clients get page 1 rather than an error.

activities.description: Flat activity list, newest first. Bursts are expanded here so existing clients keep working; read groups for the collapsed view.

cursor.description: Pass as cursor to fetch the next page. Absent when the feed is exhausted.
